title: Inspection Charge on Repairs under Northgate Protect Plans Bought after Fulfilment
content:
**Clause.** An inspection charge is added to the authorized repair value for a Northgate Protect single-item plan bought after its item was fulfilled, as the plan record shows: the first-repair inspection charge of $20.00 when no repair settlement has yet been booked on the plan, the repeat inspection charge of $10.00 when one has, and nothing on a plan bought before its item was fulfilled.

| Plan bought after its item was fulfilled | Repair settlements already booked on the plan | Inspection charge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | None | $20.00 |
| Yes | One or more | $10.00 |
| No | Any | Nothing |

## Points of judgement

- Every repair settlement on the plan's ledger counts, whatever claim it settled; replacement, reimbursement and food-loss settlements are not repair settlements.
- *Hypothetical:* a plan bought a week after its television was delivered, with one earlier repair settlement booked, adds $10.00.
